name: Replenish Nutrients Holding Corp.
summary: Replenish Nutrients Holding Corp. manufactures and sells fertilizer products in Canada. It operates in two segments, Fertilizer and Power. The company offers Super KS, a restorative regenerative fertilizer that improves soil biology; Rebuilder, a regenerative phosphate builder for depleted soils; HESO, a maintenance series of regenerative fertilizers; and Replenish Nutrients - 1, a regenerative fertilizer designed for home and garden enthusiasts. It also engages in the generation of electricity. The company is headquartered in Okotoks, Canada.
